easyPrerequisites: You are able to kill Arcbound Slith such that it won't have a -1/-1 counter on it when it dies.
description:
Kill Arcbound Slith.
When Arcbound Slith dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Arcbound Slith from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will have no counters on it due to its modular ability.
Arcbound Slith dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
